entities.summary: Dr. Menaka Guruswamy is an Indian lawyer and politician. Since 2026, she has served as a member of Parliament in the Rajya Sabha, representing West Bengal. Guruswamy is also a senior advocate at the Supreme Court of India and was the B.R. Ambedkar Research Scholar and lecturer at Columbia Law School, New York, from 2017 to 2019. Guruswamy has also been visiting faculty at Yale Law School, New York University School of Law and University of Toronto Faculty of Law.
